# What is OrderHub Desktop

**OrderHub Desktop (OHD)** is a Windows program that runs on a PC in your lab. It connects your lab's printers and scanners to OrderHub, so orders flow from your website or shop counter to the printer with as little handling as possible.

OrderHub is where orders are taken, tracked and managed. OHD is the part in your lab that does the physical work: downloading artwork, getting it ready and sending it to the right machine.

![List of Jobs in OHD](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/3a462769-d2ab-48a8-86d8-a6a4111d8531.png)

---

## Orders in, automatically

* **Downloads new orders by itself.** OHD checks OrderHub regularly for new jobs and downloads their artwork, whether it comes from your Pixfizz website or was uploaded by your staff.
* **Keeps OrderHub up to date.** As jobs are downloaded, sent to print and finished, OHD updates their status in OrderHub, so the counter always knows where an order is.
* **Works per location.** Each shop runs its own OHD and only receives the jobs meant for that shop.

---

## Sends each job to the right printer

OHD looks at each job's product and options and sends it to the printer you've set up for it. It writes the files in the format that printer expects:

| Printer / workflow | How OHD sends it |
|---|---|
| **Epson SureLab** and **Noritsu** | DPOF order folders |
| **Darkroom Pro** | Order instruction files for Darkroom's Command folder |
| **Fuji Frontier** (JobMaker) | JobMaker order files |
| **Fuji PIC Pro** | PIC Pro order files |
| **Hot folders** (Folder Copy) | Copies the files into a folder another program watches |
| **Presses and PDF workflows** (PDF Copy) | Imposes artwork onto print sheets, or passes PDFs straight through |

Jobs can print automatically, or wait for someone to check them first. That's your choice, printer by printer.

---

## Tools that save time in the lab

* **Job Review.** Check every image before it prints: crop to size, adjust colour, change quantities, or leave out an image.
* **Perfectly Clear image enhancement.** If your lab uses Perfectly Clear QuickServer, OHD can send images through it to automatically correct exposure, colour and sharpness, for print jobs, film scans and file uploads.
* **Reprints.** Reprint a whole job or just a few images (including PDF jobs) without re-downloading anything.
* **Combine jobs from the same order.** Several jobs from one order can go to the printer together as one order, where your printer supports it (Darkroom Pro, Fuji PIC Pro and Fuji Frontier).
* **Split very large jobs** into smaller batches, so one big order doesn't hold up the printer.
* **Back prints.** Print order details such as customer name and file name on the back of each photo.
* **One-cut borders for Darkroom Pro.** Place all the white space on one side of the page, so each print needs only one cut.
* **Quality check.** Optionally score every image and hold back low-quality ones for a person to look at.

---

## Film scanning

For labs that develop and scan film, OHD watches your scanner's output folders. It prepares each roll (rotating frames and creating previews), lets you review it, and uploads it to OrderHub for the customer's online gallery.

---

## Other ways in

* **File Uploads.** Upload customer files from a folder straight into OrderHub.
* **Order XML.** Bring in orders exported from other ordering systems, such as ROES.

---

## Looking after itself

* **Updates.** New versions are announced in OrderHub, under **Settings** → **Info**.
* **Backup and restore.** OHD can back up its setup every day to a network folder, so a replacement PC can be running in minutes.
* **Activity Log.** Every download, send and error is recorded, so you can see what happened to any job.

---

To install OHD and connect it to your OrderHub account, see **Setting Up OrderHub Desktop**.
